observations.text:
Requirements implemented; independent verification returned all items PASS with no deviations, so no corrections were needed.

Deliverables:
- `greet.py` — one name arg prints `Hello, <trimmed name>!`; blank input (missing or whitespace-only) exits `2` and writes an error to stderr; stdlib-only (`sys`), 18 lines.
- `USAGE.md` — normal example plus blank-input example, matching actual behavior.

Verified behaviors: `python3 greet.py Ada` → `Hello, Ada!` (exit 0); `'  Ada  '` trims to same; no-arg and whitespace-only → exit 2 with stderr-only message and empty stdout; extra args also rejected with exit 2. No files modified by the verifier and no stray artifacts.
